scope: The standing Shankaracharya hilltop shrine, historic octagonal podium, immediate rock base and stone entry steps in Srinagar.

originalReview.notes: Exact published Burke photo. Stone shrine, springing pediment, gateway and stepped octagonal platform.

quallaSearch.notes: Used the exact original Qualla Burke 1868 photo after confirming it matches the original album plate no. 2. The British Library identifies the photographer and the 1869 publication. The same original public-domain volume preserves the scaled architectural survey.
